messages:
sara: release-bot kicked off canary publish for @py-ts 3.2.0-beta -> dist-tag `canary-py` at npm and PyPI wheel staging. Need: (1) dist-tag rotation plan, (2) release notes blurb, (3) pin/backout criteria. ETA publish in 20m. @kevin @mike
kevin: on it. what's the rollout cohort? we doing 5% traffic -> 50% -> 100%?
mike: prefer staged: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation per step. fallback is roll back dist-tag to previous `canary-prev` and yank wheels on bad.
release-bot: canary publish started: artifacts uploaded to staging, checksum ok. npm tag `canary-py` created. logs: `publish --tag=canary-py`
elaine: release notes draft: "Py/TS SDK 3.2.0-beta — async client split, improved backcompat, new telemetry opt-out. Breaking: sync client deprecated." I'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/compare/...
sara: pin strategy: keep `latest` unchanged until final GA. For publishing ephemeral tokens: use ephemeral-ci token expiring 12h. @release-bot can you confirm token used?
release-bot: ephemeral token used: ok. retention: artifacts expire in 72h unless promoted.
kevin: test matrix green except windows wheels failing on py3.9. small build flake. suggest skip windows for canary, add note.
mike: agree. production rollout guard: if error rate >1% or median p95 latency regresses >20% revert dist-tag and trigger hotfix.
elaine: PR for release notes + changelog linked: <https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/412|release-notes-3.2.0-beta>
sara: starting cohort 1 now. monitoring runbook: /runbooks/release-canary.md. I'll post status updates here. :rocket: 
kevin: saw initial 10% traffic. no anomalies after 18m.
mike: 35m in, windows wheel fail not impacting hosted customers. proceed to 50%.
sara: promoted to 50%. tagging: `canary-py` -> still. reminder to update enterprise customers page for deprecation.
kevin: noticed one regression in streaming tests, investigated, it's a token refresh flake. will patch in hotfix branch if it recurs.
sara: after 2h all good. plan to close canary and prepare GA cut unless any blockers.
mike: +1, go for GA cut tomorrow in quiet window 02:00 UTC. I'll update CI gating.
sara: closing thread, will create release ticket and shiproom invite. :white_check_mark:
